options.intendedReading: Does he/she need? / Is there third-person need?
pros: Tests SALI as a bare need frame without importing KORUME/VEMI complement syntax.
risks: Bare need may be semantically incomplete outside controlled pedagogy.
Transfers VEMI complement behavior without SALI evidence.
Creates several new relations at once.
No source licenses SALI object complementation.
Would invent a new argument frame.
Does not advance L04 communicative use.

recommendation.reason: Option A isolates the only question we need to test first: whether SALI can function as a bare need head in one exact third-person question. It avoids importing KORUME/VEMI or object-complement syntax.

humanGate.approvalEffect: Select Option A for one exact candidate surface `ERU SALI KE`. This does not promote SALI beyond WATCH or license complements.
humanGate.nextIfApproved: Materialize `ERU SALI KE`, run writing coverage, then open separate linguistic validation.
